change: opt-in count-first dispatch with a streaming FFN expansion, one NVLink domain (docs/v2.1.md section 16); off by default
decision: not the default: below 2,048 tokens it does not win, and under compute load at 3A:1F it raises FFN GEMM time by up to 1.5 us even with the epilogue capped at 64 SMs (gate: <= 1 us). Recommended opt-in setting: MIN_BUCKET=2048, EPILOGUE_SMS=64, UNGATE=1 (no payload gate measures better).
setup: 4 x H200 (kermit), BF16, hidden 2048, top-k 8 of 128 experts (96 at 1A:3F), capacity 2048, CUDA graphs, 24 transport SMs; 3A:1F with the single-FFN collect view; benchmark bucket = token count
design: three independent designs, three adversarial reviews and a synthesis (workflow wf_3dc04789-149); stage A implemented and reviewed by ordering/PTX and host/JIT reviewers (wf_e537e08b-ca2: 4 minor findings, all fixed)

export PYTHONPATH=$tree PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 AFDEP_COUNT_FIRST_MIN_BUCKET=1
python -c "from afdep._build import source_digest; print(source_digest())" | tee $out/digest.txt
L="--capacity 2048 --hidden-size 2048 --top-k 8 --num-sms 24"

run h8192-fp8 4 --payload fp8 --hybrid off --capacity 256 --hidden-size 8192 --top-k 8 --num-sms 24
run sms7 4 --payload bf16 --hybrid off --num-sms 7
run sms23 4 --payload bf16 --hybrid off $L --num-sms 23
for arm in source; do export AFDEP_COUNT_FIRST_ARM=$arm; run arm-$arm 4 --payload bf16 --hybrid off $L; run arm-$arm-f1 4 --payload bf16 --hybrid off --ffn-ranks 1 $L --experts-per-ffn 32; unset AFDEP_COUNT_FIRST_ARM; done

for c in AFDEP_PAYLOAD_FIRST AFDEP_SHARED_FFN_RECEIVE AFDEP_SHARED_ROLE_KERNELS AFDEP_KEEP_ENTRY_BARRIERS AFDEP_UNION_NOTIFY AFDEP_ALL_RANK_EXIT AFDEP_GRID_SYNC_EXIT AFDEP_UNION_BUFFERS; do

done
for f in 2 1 3; do AFDEP_PAYLOAD_FIRST=1 run mixed-ffn-f$f 4 --payload bf16 --hybrid off --ffn-ranks $f $L --experts-per-ffn 32 --role-env ffn:AFDEP_SHARED_FFN_RECEIVE=1; done
timeout 300 torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=4 -m tests.gpu.deepep --payload bf16 --hybrid off --role-env ffn:AFDEP_SHARED_FFN_RECEIVE=1 > $out/n11-disagree.log 2>&1; echo "n11-disagree exit=$? agreement_error=$(grep -c 'same count-first configuration' $out/n11-disagree.log)" | tee -a $out/summary.txt
for e in eager graph; do for r in dummy duplicate negative wide; do

"""cf-faults.py <tree> <fault>: scratch fault injection for count-first (never commit). Faults: P1 P2 P3 P4 (must pass), N2 N3 (must fail)."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
tree, fault = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
I = tree / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/deep_ep/include/deep_ep/impls"
SPIN = lambda ns: ('{ unsigned long long _t0, _t1; asm volatile("mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;" : "=l"(_t0)); '
                   'do { asm volatile("mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;" : "=l"(_t1)); } while (_t1 - _t0 < ' + f'{ns}ull); }}')
def patch(name, old, new):
    p = I / name; s = p.read_text(); assert s.count(old) == 1, (name, old[:60]); p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
def P1():  # late rows: delay the NVLink store of every 5th token by 20 us (flag follows the store)
    a = "            // Issue TMA NVLink stores\n"
    patch("afdep_source_dispatch.cuh", a, f"            if (token_idx % 5 == 2) {{ {SPIN(20000)} if (token_idx % 97 == 2 and lane_idx == 0) printf(\"AFDFAULT P1\\n\"); }}\n" + a)
def P2():  # deferred flag: 10 us between store completion and flag release
    a = "    if (slot_idx >= 0) {\n        afdep_cf_st_release_sys("
    patch("afdep_count_first.cuh", a, f"    if (slot_idx >= 0 and slot_idx % 7 == 3) {{ {SPIN(10000)} if (slot_idx % 97 == 3) printf(\"AFDFAULT P2\\n\"); }}\n" + a)
def P3():  # late counts: source SM0 thread 0 waits 30 us before its count puts
    a = "            // TODO: for further optimization, we can fuse rank and expert counters\n"
    patch("afdep_source_dispatch.cuh", a, f"            if (thread_idx == 0) {{ {SPIN(30000)} printf(\"AFDFAULT P3\\n\"); }}\n" + a)
def P4():  # late prefix sums: FFN publishes P 20 us late
    a = "    afdep_cf_st_release_gpu(ptr, 1);\n}"
    patch("afdep_count_first.cuh", a, f"    {SPIN(20000)} printf(\"AFDFAULT P4\\n\");\n" + a)
def N2():  # epilogue skips the row wait (with P1): must read rows before they land
    P1()
    a = "                                                  const int lane_idx, const int rank_idx) {\n    if (lane_idx == 0) {\n        const auto flag"
    patch("afdep_count_first.cuh", a, "                                                  const int lane_idx, const int rank_idx) {\n    if (true) { if (lane_idx == 0 and slot % 97 == 0) printf(\"AFDFAULT N2\\n\"); __syncwarp(); return; }\n    if (lane_idx == 0) {\n        const auto flag")
def N3():  # epilogue skips the prefix wait (with P4): must read stale prefix sums
    P4()
    a = "                                                     const int thread_idx, const int rank_idx) {\n    if (thread_idx == 0) {\n        const auto ptr = afdep_cf_word(workspace, kAfdCfPrefixReady);\n        comm::timeout_while"
    patch("afdep_count_first.cuh", a, "                                                     const int thread_idx, const int rank_idx) {\n    if (true) { if (thread_idx == 0) printf(\"AFDFAULT N3\\n\"); __syncthreads(); return; }\n    if (thread_idx == 0) {\n        const auto ptr = afdep_cf_word(workspace, kAfdCfPrefixReady);\n        comm::timeout_while")
def P4b():  # late prefix sums: FFN CTA0 thread 0 spins 20 us between the epilogue trigger and the expert reduction
    a = "            cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion();\n\n            // Reduce expert count and add stats\n"
    patch("afdep_ffn_stream_dispatch.cuh", a, "            cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion();\n" + f"            if (thread_idx == 0) {{ {SPIN(20000)} printf(\"AFDFAULT P4b\\n\"); }}\n" + "\n            // Reduce expert count and add stats\n")
def N3b():  # epilogue skips the prefix wait while the prefix sums are late (P4b): must read stale prefix sums
    P4b()
    a = "                                                     const int thread_idx, const int rank_idx) {\n    if (thread_idx == 0) {\n        const auto ptr = afdep_cf_word(workspace, kAfdCfPrefixReady);\n        comm::timeout_while"
    patch("afdep_count_first.cuh", a, "                                                     const int thread_idx, const int rank_idx) {\n    if (true) { if (thread_idx == 0) printf(\"AFDFAULT N3b\\n\"); __syncthreads(); return; }\n    if (thread_idx == 0) {\n        const auto ptr = afdep_cf_word(workspace, kAfdCfPrefixReady);\n        comm::timeout_while")
globals()[fault]()
print("applied", fault)
